name: Meliodas
lore: Captain of the Seven Deadly Sins. A demon wielding dark purgatory energy. Collab unit.

skills.description: Does Weakpoint damage equal to ATK-scaled to one enemy.
Takes a stance. While in this stance, when attacked, Meliodas counters with damage equal to [stance.counterDamagePercent]% of his ATK. Stance lasts [stance.duration] turn.

ultimate.description: Cancels buffs and stances; does damage equal to ATK-scaled to one enemy; stuns for 2 turns.

passive.name: Deathblow
passive.description:
- All demon allies basic stats 5% 👆

# When attacking, for every 3% of maxHP lost
- Damage 2% 👆 (Uncancellable)
- Critical chance 2% 👆 (Uncancellable)
